Selected work

Ideas, built and investigated.

Complete project library →

Open methods, inspectable code, and explicit limits. The case studies distinguish numerical verification, coursework and exploratory modelling from real-system validation.

View case study →01

Energy Systems · 2026

Kerala2040 · Power-system resilience research

Diagnosis-first study of Kerala's electricity-system stress combining audited SLDC history, ERA5-sensitive demand reconstruction, hydro-timing sensitivities, transfer constraints, public-network screening, PyPSA/OSeMOSYS checks and ecological feasibility work. Screening evidence is kept separate from observed data and validated planning claims.

Python · PyPSA · OSeMOSYS · ERA5 · HiGHS · GIS · pytest

Case study →GitHub ↗
View case study →02

Thermal Systems · 2026

TES Discharge Screen · Dynamic thermal-storage screening

Techno-economic screening of industrial thermal energy storage with state-of-charge-dependent discharge constraints derived from dynamic models. Packed-bed, molten-salt and PCM cases are compared with explicit verification, sensitivity and validation boundaries.

Python · Pyomo · HiGHS · Modelica · FMI/FMPy · SALib

Case study →GitHub ↗
View case study →03

Energy Systems · 2026

OpenSteamOpt · Steam & power RTO

An open-source two-boiler steam-and-power twin with a carbon-aware Pyomo/HiGHS scheduler, OpenModelica FMI 2.0 simulation and a local Streamlit advisory GUI. Synthetic and uncalibrated; not an ABB product or live control system.

Python · Modelica · Pyomo · HiGHS · FMI/FMPy · Streamlit · pytest

Case study →GitHub ↗
View case study →04

Energy Systems · 2026

GB-FLEXABM · Electricity investment

Local electricity-investment GUI and shared Pyomo/HiGHS planner, with audited market coverage and 175 extracted public input references. Synthetic and uncalibrated; normalization, price-target decisions and weather conversion still gate historical fitting.

Python · Pyomo · HiGHS · Streamlit · NumPy · pytest

Case study →GitHub ↗
View case study →05

Thermal Systems · 2026

ThermoTwin-F · Educational gas turbine

How do degradation and thermal transients affect a gas turbine? A Make-built educational simulator checked against hand calculations, an analytical transient and repeatable sensor-noise tests. Not commercial-engine validation.

Fortran 2008 · Python · Win32/GDI+

Case study →GitHub ↗

Energy Systems · 2026

PyPSA-NL · Grid flexibility

How do corridor limits and flexibility change dispatch? A Netherlands-inspired screening model with hand-checkable congestion and storage tests. Synthetic topology; not a validated Dutch grid.

PyPSA · Linopy · HiGHS · Streamlit · Python

Research direction

Questions that connect the work.

Full research statement →
I

Thermal engineering

How do geometry, surface condition and thermal resistance affect high-temperature heat transfer? I’m interested in transient CHT and carefully bounded experimental–numerical comparison.

Thermal methods & evidence →
II

Energy systems modelling

How do demand, network limits and storage change system decisions? My work explores heat and power dispatch, grid flexibility, hydrogen and electricity investment.

Energy systems work →
III

Industrial decarbonisation

How can operational data support defensible energy decisions? My focus includes energy-performance indicators, load drivers, metering gaps and transparent emissions calculations.

Industrial methodology →
IV

Nuclear-energy applications

How can existing thermal-fluid, systems and computational engineering skills transfer into nuclear R&D? I’m exploring nuclear thermal-hydraulics and reactor systems while building the nuclear-specific foundation needed for credible work.

Research direction →
